parallel.implementation: The parent wrote a pure local ESM implementation with modules for argparse behavior, output printing, markdown text helpers, inline rendering, block rendering, and test14.mjs.

serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial run kept all work in one agent: probe executable behavior, implement parser and wrapper modules, test locally, and deliver.
serial.implementation: The serial artifact contains CLI parsing modules plus a reference-runner that uses node:child_process to spawn /workspace/dataset/test14_executable for the core output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The wrapper modules and test14.mjs were assembled into /output and artifact validation captured them, but the delivered logic is not a self-contained JS migration.

serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No native markdown implementation was produced, and the final response confirms forwarding to the executable; the official evaluation completed with 0 of 69 samples passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel pursued the prompt's native ESM/local-module requirement and implemented a JS renderer, though not complete enough for all hidden cases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial followed ESM file layout and parser requirements but violated the native implementation boundary by delegating markdown output to the dataset executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both understood the surface CLI task, but serial selected a prohibited reference-executable strategy while parallel attempted the required native port.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavior discovery to CLI and markdown children while the parent retained final implementation and delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and kept probing, implementation, verification, and finalization in one local execution path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had extra child lifecycle management to perform; serial had no coordination boundary but also no independent native renderer owner beyond the same agent.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs are encrypted, but visible behavior shows children understood CLI and markdown probing; the parent did not establish a later return/integration checkpoint before interrupting them.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no inter-agent handoff; its interface was an internal CLI parser feeding a reference-runner module.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material context difference is not a missing initial brief but the parallel result lifecycle ending before child findings and possible module work were returned.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a native markdown subset in local ESM files, including headings, lists, paragraph rendering, inline code, HTML tag preservation, and TOC id handling.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented the CLI shell and then invoked the packaged Python executable for the actual markdown conversion.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced an incomplete but self-contained renderer; serial produced an accurate local smoke-test wrapper that was not a valid migration artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child results in flight, waited twice, then interrupted the top-level CLI and markdown children before they returned final outputs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; it finished its own patch, read the files back, and finalized.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed with unfinished delegated work, while serial's problem was not result retrieval but the invalid executable-forwarding design.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final tree came from the parent-applied patch and artifact validation listed the expected local module tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final tree was also assembled cleanly, but one module hard-coded the reference executable path as part of the deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no proven parallel write collision; the material integration difference is native module assembly versus executable wrapper assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran a side-by-side harness and fixed observed sample mismatches, then reported CLI and sample parity before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also tested CLI and representative markdown cases locally, but those checks passed through the same reference executable dependency it delivered.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's local verification tested its own renderer on selected cases; serial's local verification did not validate an independent JS markdown implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used four subagents and 449 agent seconds, waited on children near the end, then interrupted them and finalized without their top-level returns.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 355 agent seconds and no subagents; it completed its planned wrapper before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent extra coordination budget and closed with cancelled delegated work, whereas serial closed a simpler but invalid design.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail: parallel failed with 26/69 samples and serial failed with 0/69. The concrete task-solving difference is that the parallel run attempted a native ESM markdown renderer and therefore achieved partial hidden-case coverage, while the serial run delivered a wrapper that calls /workspace/dataset/test14_executable after parsing arguments. That serial approach locally reproduced outputs but violated the migration requirement to implement the logic in Node.js without embedding or calling Python behavior. The retained parallel cancellation pattern is adverse because child work was lost, but it is not an outcome-differential explanation for pass/fail because neither run passed.
parallel_contributors: Native local ESM renderer and CLI implementation gave partial official coverage.
Interrupted top-level children left additional markdown and CLI work unavailable before final delivery.
serial_contributors: Serial implemented a reference-executable forwarding module instead of a self-contained JS markdown implementation.
Local serial checks passed because the same reference executable existed during the run.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's reliance on /workspace/dataset/test14_executable is an ordinary implementation/design defect, not a coordination error.
Parallel's handwritten markdown subset remained incomplete for hidden official cases.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
